chunks: They come down to every mendacious sinner,

key_terms.أَثِيمٍ: A sinner, one who bears a burden of sin
key_terms.أَفَّاقٍ: A liar, one who speaks falsely

ai.seo_question: Who do the angels descend upon according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as describing the descent of inspiration upon poets, distinguishing between those inspired by the Holy Spirit (Jibril) and those by the devils (Shayatin). It underscores that poetic eloquence does not guarantee truth, as false poets are characterized by their tendency to lie and commit sins, serving as a critique of pre-Islamic and contemporary poetic arrogance.
